Elena — thanks for the packet, and for the draft endorsement. A few items we need to close before Procurement can issue a PO: 

1) Additional insured scope
- Redwood requires Additional Insured on Commercial General Liability (CG 20 10 or equivalent) and Umbrella. Your note that PI (E&O) cannot include AI is fine — please confirm that the GL endorsement will include "ongoing and completed operations."

2) Limits and waiver
- Our target minimums are $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate for GL, and $1,000,000 Umbrella. If you have higher limits, great — send them. Also confirm whether your carrier will provide Waiver of Subrogation and Primary & Non-Contributory language in the endorsement.

3) Certificate holder and PO routing
- Please add certificate holder: Redwood Inference, Inc., 201 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105
- For PO processing, Procurement needs the vendor legal name and remit-to bank details (ABA, account) and the vendor contact for invoices. If you prefer us to set up via Ariba / vendor portal, note that as well.

4) W-9 / EIN
- The attached W-9 shows an EIN, but Procurement needs a signed W-9 with a company signature block. Can you re-send the signed PDF?

Next steps: if you can confirm the endorsement language (we reviewed your draft and suggested one small tweak to include ‘Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors and employees’), Procurement can provisionally create a PO and set the activation as "conditional upon carrier endorsement upload."

I'll loop Ben from Procurement for PO creation and Marissa to track the activation timeline.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
